seoTitle: How to Reset Your TradingView Account the Right Way
metaDescription: Learn what resetting a TradingView account actually means, from clearing chart layouts and watchlists to resetting paper trading balance in 2026.
intro: There's no single 'reset account' button in TradingView, but there are several ways to get a clean slate depending on what you actually want to clear. This guide breaks down how to reset chart layouts, clear watchlists, and reset your paper trading balance, plus when creating a new account might be the better option. It's aimed at anyone who wants a fresh start without losing important settings unintentionally.

steps.heading: Understand what 'reset account' means
steps.body: TradingView doesn't offer a single full account reset; instead, different elements like layouts, watchlists, and paper trading balances are reset separately.

steps.heading: Reset your chart layout
steps.body: Remove indicators, drawings, and custom settings from your chart to return it to a default view.

steps.heading: Clear or delete watchlists
steps.body: Go into your watchlist panel and remove symbols or entire lists you no longer need to declutter your workspace.

steps.heading: Reset Paper Trading balance
steps.body: Use the paper trading settings to restore your simulated account back to its default starting balance.

steps.heading: Consider creating a new account if needed
steps.body: If you need a truly fresh start beyond layouts and watchlists, creating a new TradingView account may be the simplest option.

faq.question: Can I fully reset a TradingView account in one click?
faq.answer: No, there isn't a single reset-everything button; you need to reset chart layouts, watchlists, and paper trading balance individually.

faq.question: Will resetting my chart layout delete my saved indicators?
faq.answer: Resetting the layout typically removes indicators and drawings from the current view, though saved layouts elsewhere in your account may remain untouched.

faq.question: How do I get my paper trading balance back to default?
faq.answer: You can reset your Paper Trading balance from within the paper trading panel to restore the default starting amount.

faq.question: When should I just create a new account instead of resetting?
faq.answer: If you want to completely start over, including your profile and history, creating a new account is often simpler than resetting individual settings.
